limits: Browser fixture images are layout examples, not full native desktop screenshots.
The reference comparison checks the visual recipe and animation; independently generated noise means patterns are not pixel-identical.
The launcher startup race is covered by protocol fixtures; the current desktop app was not exited or restarted.
Native settings appearance and end-to-end chat behavior still require owner review.
Native callback timings cover one manual replay without navigation, not a benchmark of actual chat loading or guaranteed frame rate.
